data.summary: TEST CALL. Caller wants full interiors for a new 3BHK in Baner, possession in January. Asked about per sq ft rate.

transcript.text: Thank you for calling Aangan Studio. This call may be recorded. How can I help?
Hi, we need full interiors for our new 3BHK in Baner, about 1400 square feet. Possession is in January.
Lovely. What budget range are you working with?
Around 10 to 12 lakh. What's your per square foot rate?
Your designer will walk you through pricing on the consultation. I have Thursday at 4pm or Friday at 11am.
